Here is a complete example of a single simulation.

```{r}
#| label: example
#| cache: true
#| time_it: true
set.seed(STARTREK)

start <- 500
end <- 3500
n_clusters <- 5
n_samples <- 1250

chronology <- simulate_chronology(start, end, n_clusters)
samples <- sample_dates(chronology, n_samples, calibration = intcal20)
calibrated_dates <- calibrate(samples, intcal20)

models <- list(
  spd = spd(calibrated_dates),
  ckde = ckde(calibrated_dates),
  bgmm = bgmm(calibrated_dates),
  dpmm = dpmm(samples),
  netc = netc(calibrated_dates),
  oracle = chronology
)

densities <- lapply(models, density, years = seq(start, end))
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-example-densities
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
svglite(
  filename = "figures/example-densities.svg",
  width = 5.5,
  height = 4
)

layout(
  matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 3), nrow = 3, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  heights = c(0.7, 0.08, 1),
  widths = c(1, 0.01, 0.23)
)

par(defaults)
par(mai = c(0, 0.65, 0, 0))

plot(
  subset(intcal20, cal_age <= end & cal_age >= start),
  xlab = NULL,
  xaxs = "i",
  yaxs = "i"
)

par(mai = c(0.5, 0.65, 0, 0))

with(
  rbind(densities[["dpmm"]], densities[["netc"]]),
  new_plot(
    xlim = c(start, end),
    ylim = c(min(conf_lo, na.rm = TRUE), max(conf_hi, na.rm = TRUE)),
    xaxs = "i",
    yaxs = "i"
  )
)

x_axis()
y_axis()

x_label("Years Before Present (t)")
y_label("Density", line = 2.5)

add_grid()

with(densities, {
  plot(bgmm, add = TRUE, col = theme("BGMM"))
  plot(dpmm, add = TRUE, col = theme("DPMM"), se = TRUE)
  plot(netc, add = TRUE, col = theme("NetC14"), se = TRUE)
  plot(ckde, add = TRUE, col = theme("CKDE"))
  plot(spd, add = TRUE, col = theme("SPD"), lty = "dotted")
  plot(oracle, add = TRUE, col = theme("Oracle"), lwd = 2, lty = "dashed")
})

par(mai = rep(0, 4))
new_plot(c(0, 1), c(0, 1))
add_legend(
  "center",
  legend = c("True p(t)", "SPD", "CKDE", "BGMM", "DPMM", "NetC14"),
  col = theme("Oracle", "SPD", "CKDE", "BGMM", "DPMM", "NetC14"),
  text.col = theme("Oracle", "SPD", "CKDE", "BGMM", "DPMM", "NetC14"),
  lwd = rep(1.2, 6),
  lty = c("dashed", "dotted", "solid", "solid", "solid", "solid")
)

dev.off()
```

Note: the above figure is pretty noisy, so we show uncertainty intervals only 
for DPMM and NetC14.

**Estimate age**

Getting the posterior distribution over ages for each sample is just a matter of
multiplying the chronology across each row of the calibration matrix and then
dividing each row by its sum:

$$
p(t \mid F_{i}, \theta) = \frac{p(F_{i} \mid t) \hspace{2pt} p(t \mid \theta)}{p(F_{i} \mid \theta)}
$$

In matrix form, that is

$$
\mathbf{Q} = \mathrm{diag}(\mathbf{h})^{-1} \mathbf{M} \hspace{2pt} \mathrm{diag}(\mathbf{v})
$$

The resulting matrix $\mathbf{Q}$ has the same dimensions as $\mathbf{M}$.
Getting a scalar estimate of age for each radiocarbon sample just requires
drawing an age from each row of $\mathbf{Q}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\hat{t}_{i} &\sim p(t \mid F_{i}, \,\theta) \\[6px]
\hat{t}_{i} &\sim \mathrm{Categorical}(\mathbf{Q}_{i})
\end{aligned}
$$

In R: 

```{r}
#| label: example-posterior
years <- seq(start, end)
v <- densities[["netc"]][["density"]]
q <- t(t(calibrated_dates) * v)
q <- q / rowSums(q)

i <- 1
t_hat <- sample(years, size = 1, prob = q[i, ])
```

Sampling in this way pulls the probability mass of the sample towards the modes
of mixture density. The figure below demonstrates this. The blue line shows the
calibration likelihood of a sample, the orange line shows the prior, i.e., the
chronology or density estimated by the mixture, and the brown line shows the
posterior, or the product of the likelihood and the prior. The crucial result is
to concentrate the probability mass at the nearest mode in the density, which is
presumably where the sample comes from.

```{r}
#| label: plot-example-age
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
curve <- subset(intcal20, cal_age >= start & cal_age <= end)

Si <- 2700

f14c_mu <- subset(curve, cal_age == Si)[["f14c_mu"]]
f14c_sigma <- f14c_mu * 25 / LIBBY

Ci <- calibrate_sample(f14c_mu, f14c_sigma, curve)
Ci <- Ci / sum(Ci)

modes <- c(2475, 2725)
v <- 0.2 * dnorm(years, modes[1], 40) + 0.8 * dnorm(years, modes[2], 40)
v <- v / sum(v)

Pi <- Ci * v
Pi <- Pi / sum(Pi)

support <- which(Ci > max(Ci) * 0.0001 | v > max(v) * 0.01)
xlim <- c(years[min(support)], years[max(support)])

svglite(
  filename = "figures/example-age.svg",
  width = 5.5,
  height = 4
)

layout(
  matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 3), nrow = 3, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  heights = c(0.7, 0.08, 1),
  widths = c(1, 0.01, 0.23)
)

par(defaults)
par(mai = c(0, 0.65, 0, 0))

plot(
  subset(curve, cal_age <= xlim[2] & cal_age >= xlim[1]),
  xlab = NULL,
  xaxs = "i",
  yaxs = "i"
)

par(mai = c(0.5, 0.65, 0, 0))

new_plot(
  xlim = xlim,
  ylim = c(0, max(Ci, v, Pi) * 1.05),
  xaxs = "i",
  yaxs = "i"
)

x_axis()
y_axis()

x_label("Years Before Present (t)")
y_label("Density", line = 2.5)

add_grid()

abline(v = Si, col = coolors("gray"), lty = "dashed", lwd = 1.1)
text(
  x = Si + 10,
  y = max(Ci, v, Pi) * 1.03,
  labels = "True age",
  adj = c(0, 1),
  col = coolors("gray"),
  cex = 0.9
)

lines(years, Ci, col = coolors("blue"))
lines(years, v, col = coolors("orange"))
lines(years, Pi, col = coolors("brown"), lwd = 1.3)

par(mai = rep(0, 4))
new_plot(c(0, 1), c(0, 1))
add_legend(
  "center",
  legend = c("Likelihood", "Prior", "Posterior"),
  col = coolors("blue", "orange", "brown"),
  text.col = coolors("blue", "orange", "brown"),
  lwd = c(1, 1, 1.3),
  lty = c("solid", "solid", "solid")
)

dev.off()
```
